mechanics.claim: The damage hits the first enemy struck by the bola.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: Buffered Q/W casts during E's cast time execute when E completes, allowing near-simultaneous casts.
mechanics.quote: If '''Rengar''' casts {{ai|Savagery|Rengar}} and/or {{ai|Battle Roar|Rengar}} during ''Bola Strike's'' cast time, he will buffer them and cast them when ''Bola Strike'' completes.

mechanics.claim: With Unseen Predator empowerment (leaping), the ability has no cast time.
With Ferocity (Unseen Predator) empowerment, the damage scales differently by champion level instead of ability rank, and the target is rooted instead of slowed.
mechanics.quote: ''Bola Strike's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|50 + (305-50)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}}. The target is {{tip|root|rooted}} instead of {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
